about: Vehicle packages their authors submitted and the project reviewed (#530, #580; docs/vehicles.md, Packages: how to submit one). The menu's Vehicles… lists them; the player installs one from its url: a package.json or a .zip on its author's host, or hosted/<name>.zip, which the project hosts where its author allowed it (the user, 2026-11-15, #580). Entries are written by tools/submissions.py --accept.
